question: Should OpenClaw runtime Docker/Podman containers expose the agent workspace at `/workspace`, or should `/workspace` remain reserved for sandbox containers with runtime docs updated accordingly?
rationale: Both outcomes are plausible, but the choice changes container setup behavior, Docker/Podman parity, and sandbox path semantics across user-facing install surfaces.

options.title: Implement consistent runtime alias
options.body: Add a `/workspace` alias or bind contract across Dockerfile, Compose, setup helpers, Podman/Quadlet, docs, and smoke coverage.

options.title: Document sandbox-only semantics
options.body: Keep runtime containers on `/home/node/.openclaw/workspace` and update any docs/templates that imply `/workspace` is generally available.

options.title: Resolve DooD path work first
options.body: Let the adjacent Docker-out-of-Docker sandbox path contract settle before adding a runtime alias.

recommendation.title: Implement consistent runtime alias
recommendation.body: Add a `/workspace` alias or bind contract across Dockerfile, Compose, setup helpers, Podman/Quadlet, docs, and smoke coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the broadest recent Docker/setup/docs history among the implicated surfaces and are already tied to adjacent Docker/sandbox contract work.
